regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your favor of September 30. Your "write-up" in the best weekly news-paper, THE NEW WORLD, was very ood. Father Elmer, the Master of Novices, smilingly called my attention to it. I do hope you get time from your busy duties of nursing, to be as successful with your "write", about the, comparatively little known though prolific Seraphic Mass Association. In regard to the benefits and blessings reported as through this quiet little organization, I have longsince been convinced and have frequently exclaimed ---
